summary.text: Josh Taveras is the Democratic candidate for New York State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat with no incumbent.

A store manager and Stony Brook University graduate, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifelong Long Islander running on affordability, community and what he called pragmatic progressive leadership.

paragraphs.text: Josh Taveras was born in Bay Shore, New York, and graduated from Walter G. O'Connell Copiague High School before earning a bachelor's degree from Stony Brook University in 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a first-generation Dominican American who grew up in Copiague in a working-class family, and said he earned a political science degree after working through retail management, public service and higher education.
Taveras also sought the Democratic nomination for New York's 2nd Congressional District but did not appear on the June 23, 2026 primary ballot.

In his Ballotpedia survey for the State Senate race, he listed three key messages: affordability, progressive values paired with responsible governance, and a campaign focused on listening to constituents.
He named affordability and economic security, housing stability, healthcare access, education equity, workers' rights, climate resilience and civil rights as the policy areas he focuses on.
